name: MonarchAiStopButton
title: AiStopButton
summary: The Stop control of a streaming assistant response: a secondary button with a filled square, replaced by "Stopped." and an optional Continue button once the response has stopped.
whenToUse: Next to a response that is streaming, so the person can stop it.
whenNotToUse: For cancelling a form or a dialog use MonarchButton with "Cancel". For a task with progress use the cancel action of that task's component.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAiStopButton(onStop: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, size: MonarchButtonSize = MonarchButtonSize.Sm, enabled: Boolean = true, stopped: Boolean = false, showLabel: Boolean = true, onContinue: (() -> Unit)? = null, stopLabel: String? = null, stoppedLabel: String? = null, continueLabel: String? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)

options.name: onStop
options.description: Called when Stop is activated. Abort the request here.

options.name: size
options.description: The height of the Stop and Continue buttons. The touch target is at least 48dp at every size.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether Stop can be activated, for example false while the abort is in flight.

options.name: stopped
options.description: Whether the response has stopped. Replaces Stop with the stopped text.

options.name: showLabel
options.description: Shows the title beside the square. When false the title is still the TalkBack name.

options.name: onContinue
options.description: Adds a ghost Continue button to the stopped state.

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: The source of the interactions of the Stop button.

states.name: running
states.description: A secondary MonarchButton with a filled square and the title "Stop".

states.name: running, symbol only
states.description: With showLabel false only the square shows; the button is still named "Stop".

states.name: disabled
states.description: The Stop button in the disabled colors.

states.name: stopped
states.description: The button is replaced by "Stopped." in the muted text color.

states.name: stopped with Continue
states.description: The stopped text followed by a ghost Continue button.

appearance: Stop is a secondary MonarchButton: the surface fill, the default border and the default text color, with the square in the content color. The stopped text uses the muted text color. The same roles apply in light, dark and high contrast.
platformNotes: The web offers sm and md; Android takes any MonarchButtonSize, so Lg also works, as on iOS. The web's buttonProps pass-through has no equivalent: pass a modifier. The stopped text is a live region that stays in the layout from the start, so the change is announced; the web uses a role="status" element in the same way and iOS posts an announcement. When Stop had keyboard focus as it was removed, focus moves to Continue, as on the web; TalkBack focus is left to the system. Escape is not wired: the screen that owns the request decides.
accessibility: Stop is a Material 3 button named "Stop", also when showLabel is false. The square is drawn inside it and has no semantics of its own.
The stopped text is a polite live region that is in the layout before it has text, so "Stopped." is announced when the response stops.
Stop and Continue keep a 48dp touch target at every size.
When the stopped text and Continue do not fit on one line, Continue moves under it.
If Stop had keyboard focus when it was replaced, focus moves to Continue.
edgeCases: The component does not track the request; it shows Stop until stopped is set.
stopped with no onContinue shows only the text; there is nothing to activate.
The empty stopped text keeps the height of one line in the row while Stop shows.
